subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable shape should replace inline per-session `systemPromptReport` storage while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe and useful `/context` diagnostics?
rationale: The remaining fix is not purely mechanical because current source intentionally persists the report for warning dedupe, while field data shows the full report now dominates session-store size.

options.title: Persist minimal warning state
options.body: Store only compact warning-dedupe metadata in session rows and make bulky report sections current-turn or diagnostic-only.

options.title: Move full reports out of line
options.body: Store bulky reports in an approved compact state store or content-addressed design while session rows keep small references and cleanup ownership.

options.title: Keep inline reports
options.body: Retain current inline reports and rely on entry caps and disk budgets, accepting continued duplicated metadata in retained session rows.

recommendation.title: Persist minimal warning state
recommendation.body: Store only compact warning-dedupe metadata in session rows and make bulky report sections current-turn or diagnostic-only.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns both sides of the history: prompt-report introduction and the current skill-prompt dedupe mitigation.
